# Cheesy Tomato Pasta Bake (with zucchini, capsicum, spinach)

Serves 4 generous portions (a real-life portion size; stretches to 5-6 smaller meal-prep portions). Fridge 3-4 days, freezes up to 3 months.

## Ingredients
- 500g penne
- 2 brown onions, chopped
- 3-4 garlic cloves, crushed
- 2 zucchini, diced
- 1 red capsicum, diced
- 2 x 700g passata
- 1 tbsp dried mixed herbs (from home)
- 280g baby spinach (use as much as you like; it wilts right down)
- About 300g shredded mozzarella (some left over from the 700g bag)
- Olive oil, salt, pepper (from home)
- Optional: chilli flakes, a pinch of sugar, ricotta, parmesan, mince

## Method
1. Boil the penne until about 2 minutes short of done, then drain.
2. Soften the onions in a little oil. Add the capsicum and zucchini and cook a few minutes.
3. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
4. Add the passata and mixed herbs, season, and simmer 10 minutes.
5. Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the pasta and half the mozzarella.
6. Tip into a baking dish and top with the rest of the mozzarella.
7. Bake at 200C for 15-20 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

## Notes
- For meal prep, portion into containers before or after baking, and reheat single serves in the microwave.
- Adapted from common pasta bake recipes (Foodbanjo, Ninja Kitchen, Kylee Cooks). Oven time and temperature are my own suggestion.
